thesis: Seven of these eight signals carry the same templated 'operator runtime' summary on unrelated pages (a governance-theory paper, an untitled arXiv page, a coding-harness paper, a Microsoft transparency note, a Nostr identity paper, two OpenClaw docs pages), so the apparent demand for new Shadow infrastructure comes from the scout's template rather than the frontier. I read only titles and summaries in this run, not the sources, and none shows a missing Shadow behaviour. Using an incumbent does not apply: OpenClaw exec approvals and NostrAgent are not platforms a Shadow workload runs on, and nothing shows Shadow's existing approval path failing. A technical contribution has no demonstrated gap to fill, and doing nothing about the signals costs nothing. The only supported move is operational: this loop has now proposed confirming closure of the four Oct 17-21 probes six times without verifying it, and I did not verify it in this run either. No commercial hypothesis is added; no buyer is behind any of these signals.
doctrine: When the loop proposes the same operational closure a second time without verification, it stops being a thesis and goes out as the single next action with a stopping condition, so one run either closes it or records why it cannot.
proof_artifact: Resolution records for the four elapsed bets, written only where missing after verification: 20261017T131922 (PinkWallet; 'not executed' unless the duplicate-submission test was actually run), 20261019T132106 (Mastan exchange; silence closed Oct 26 unless a reply exists), 20261020T152055 (Instructor ratification; retired as superseded by the Oct 24 wind-down, with no post and no restoration of comment access), 20261021T161916 (Moltbook diligence ask; read back the post, and answer or explicitly close any qualifying question). Each record states what was read back, the outcome class, and the one decision it changes. Beneficiary: Will and later loop runs, through fewer stale 'running' bets and no further repeat proposals. If all four records already exist, write nothing.
proof_next_action: In Shadow's bets ledger, look up the four IDs 20261017T131922, 20261019T132106, 20261020T152055 and 20261021T161916 and read their current status (read-only first). For any still marked running, write the resolution record described in the artifact. If the ledger read is denied, as it was on Nov 24, record that denial once as the blocker on those four bets. Stopping condition: once all four have a resolution record or a recorded read blocker, drop this item from future loop proposals. No outbound post, no GitHub activity and no new probe is part of this action.
